Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The agent failed to correctly execute the tool calls required to access the specific Wikipedia edit history. Instead of successfully retrieving the edit log for February 29, 2004, the agent entered the date into an input field but did not subsequently click the "Submit" button (target_id 186) to generate the results. Consequently, the agent never received the data showing the removed text. Instead of recognizing this lack of result and trying a different approach or re-executing the submission, the agent hallucinated an answer ("Dragons are creatures that are infamously hard to kill...") based on the fact that no results were returned, leading to an incorrect solution.
